# Firefox Mobile feature taxonomy

17 areas (L1) and 80 features (L2), shared by iOS and Android. Code, TestRail cases and bugs
are attributed to the L2 ID; L1 is the first part of the ID. An L1 ID alone (e.g. `CRED`) is allowed for code
that serves the whole area. — means the feature doesn't exist on that platform.

## Not product features

Code that serves many features goes to a shared bucket, reported separately so it stays visible. Code that isn't counted at all is excluded.

| ID | Covers |
|---|---|
| `SHARED.SHELL` | Browser shell: app/scene lifecycle, browser view controller, coordinators, routing |
| `SHARED.ARCH` | Architecture and utilities: Redux, dependency injection, extensions, helpers |
| `SHARED.UI` | Shared UI: component library, theming infrastructure, generic views |
| `SHARED.DATA` | Shared data layer: profile, storage infrastructure, networking |
| `SHARED.WEB` | Web engine integration: web views, user scripts, internal schemes |
| `SHARED.TELEMETRY` | Telemetry infrastructure |
| `SHARED.EXPERIMENTS` | Nimbus, feature flags and remote configuration infrastructure |
| `EXCLUDED` | Generated code, strings, third-party code and test support |
